title: Declare PointsLedger.redemptionId as a real FK to RewardRedemptions instead of a comment-only reference
rule: profileId-in-PK-adjacent referential-integrity discipline / Evans (invariant enforced in one place, not just documented)

evidence.quote: /// Optional FK to [RewardRedemptions.id] for redemption-related entries.

why: The comment asserts a foreign-key relationship the schema never declares. Nothing stops redemptionId from pointing at a nonexistent row, or (with no DB check) at a redemption belonging to a different profile if a future query bug wires the wrong id.
recommendation: Add `.references(RewardRedemptions, #id)` in a schema migration (RewardRedemptions rows are never hard-deleted today, so KeyAction.noAction/restrict is reasonable).
acceptance_criteria: Migration adds the FK; a new test asserts inserting a PointsLedger row with a bogus redemptionId fails.

corrections: Same root-cause defect also exists at completion_events.dart:38 (trackId comment-FK to CurriculumTracks, no .references()) within this same batch's scope - should have been merged as sites:2 per digest rule 4 (learning_ledger.dart:47's trackId, by contrast, does use real .references()).
